name: ck-social-contributions
description: Prepare selected Cook Islands National Superannuation Fund employee and employer classification, earnings and conditional contribution working papers for a qualified reviewer in 2026. Use for CINSF eligibility, age exclusions, historical opt-out evidence, termination earnings, ordinary employee and employer shares, payable-month intake and evidenced remittance matching. Includes primary law, fictional ordinary and held positions, payment patterns and source conflicts. Holds unverified current instruments, rounding, foreign workers, cross-month payments, prescribed forms and complete social contribution outputs. This source-cited draft does not establish a complete payroll, contribution schedule, filing authority or comprehensive Cook Islands coverage.
